title: Read SARSA's next-action target
description: You follow the selected action into the update and the following environment step.

steps.description: You initialize Q, exploration, and returns. Each episode resets the environment and chooses an initial action.
You sample a transition and select an for the next state. The target uses Q[ns, an] when the episode continues.

steps.question: Which action is carried into the next loop pass?
steps.answer: The assignment a=an carries the selected next action forward. That same an also supplies the continuing update target.

steps.description: You accumulate return, decay eps, and return Q with episode returns. The example calls are commented out, and the supplied recording contains no output.
